work_packages.name: M1R3 three-stage solve and accounting repair
work_packages.stage1: maximize seven-year profit; warm start from the best valid M0/M1/M1R incumbent; 180 seconds; target relative MIP gap 1%
work_packages.stage2: require at least 99.9% of the stage-1 incumbent and minimize activation count; 90 seconds
work_packages.stage3: fix the best stage-2 activation count and maximize profit again; 60 seconds; use this exported solution
work_packages.purpose: retain a known feasible baseline, improve bounds, and remove unused sales-variable slack from the final export

work_packages.name: management Pareto diagnostic
work_packages.design: remove the hard cap of seven plots while retaining the 50% minimum selected area; find a profit incumbent for 120 seconds, then minimize activations at 99.9%, 99.5%, and 99.0% retained profit for 60 seconds each
work_packages.comparators: cap7 M1R3 and the existing cap10 diagnostic
work_packages.purpose: show the amount of profit exchanged for a simpler planting plan instead of treating seven plots as a fact

work_packages.name: strict bean-coverage diagnostic
work_packages.design: replace the aggregate bean-area proxy with the sufficient condition that every rolling three-year window contains at least one full-plot bean season; include a 2023 full-plot bean season only when the source area equals the plot area
work_packages.purpose: measure the cost of a conservative rule that really guarantees spatial coverage; do not silently make it the main rule

work_packages.name: scenario stability, independent verification, and draft export
work_packages.design: cross-evaluate each valid plan under D0/D05/D10 with the same sale rule; compute profit regret, area L1 change, activation Jaccard similarity, and crop-area changes; independently verify every chosen CSV and the two D0 workbook copies

hard_constraints: same as Q1-TRIAL-v1 unless a run is explicitly labeled as a management or bean diagnostic
primary_outputs: six M1R3 run directories and comparison tables
draft copies of result1_1.xlsx and result1_2.xlsx only if the selected D0 solutions pass CSV and workbook verification
success_rules: Every retained main solution has zero independently detected hard-constraint violations
No retained main solution has lower attainable profit than its M0 fallback
Report solver status, bound, gap, and time; a time-limited solution is not called globally optimal
Stage-3 internal profit and independently recomputed export profit agree within 0.1 yuan
Any claimed improvement is compared on identical data, demand scenario, sale rule, and hard constraints
Management and strict-bean relaxations or strengthenings remain diagnostics and are not promoted automatically
stop_conditions: Stop immediately on a frozen-data hash mismatch, new semantic conflict, missing valid fallback, hard-constraint violation, or objective discrepancy above 0.1 yuan
Stop starting new solves when the 55-minute wall budget is reached and preserve completed evidence
If a proposed improvement does not beat the incumbent reliably, retain M1R/M0 and report the failed improvement
After reporting and independent verification, stop at D; do not freeze Q1 or enter Q2 without a new explicit user decision
